For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Prem Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ajit Kumar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAMESH CHAND  MALVIYA  ORAL ORDER 3 14-03-2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Fatuha P.S. Case No. 69 of 2016 and Special Case (POCSO) No. 51 of 2016 registered for the offence under Sections 376 / 511 of IPC.

3. As per the prosecution case while the informant's daughter went to attend natures call in the meantime petitioner catched the victim girl, the victim girl started crying and many people came on the spot, the petitioner kept pistol in his hand tried to flee away but but was apprehended by the police on the spot.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.77396 of 2023(3) dt.14-03-2024 present case.
5. However, learned APP for the State vehemently opposed the prayer for regular bail.

6. On perusal of the FIR and impugned order dated 23.09.2023 passed by learned A.D.J. - VII - Cum - Special Judge, Patna, it appears that this is a case of misuse of bail and the petitioner is continuously absent before the trial Court since 18.07.2016 in POCSO case for about 7 years.
